theorem_rows.name: activated_tail_support_bijection
theorem_rows.statement: For each P and side, every no-slot atom is a disjoint b-interval and q=P-2b gives a bijection to the activated tail support.

theorem_rows.name: noslot_load_support_identity
theorem_rows.statement: NoSlotLoad equals the number of primes q in the activated tail support Q_side(P).

theorem_rows.name: total_pressure_support_pdec_normal_form
theorem_rows.statement: A total pressure defect is exactly W_side(P)<=2*pi(Q_side(P)), with Q_side(P) explicitly registered.

theorem_rows.name: finite_total_pressure_support_pdec_absence
theorem_rows.statement: The finite audit finds no registered total pressure support PDEC up to the tested bound.

theorem_rows.name: support_pdec_exclusion
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof still needs to exclude W_side(P)<=2*pi(Q_side(P)) for the activated support, or route persistent failures to phase/SAE/ColumnCRT certificates.

plain_conclusion: 本步把 `PrimeWindow<=2*NoSlotLoad` 的总压力缺陷登记为精确的激活尾支撑 PDEC。对固定 `P,side`，每个 no-slot 层原子都是互不重叠的 b 区间，`q=P-2b` 给出到尾素支撑的双射；因此 `NoSlotLoad` 正是该支撑里的素数个数。任意终端反例现在必须满足 `W_side(P)<=2*pi(Q_side(P))`，其中 `Q_side(P)` 已由同一 formal unit 显式给出。有限审计未发现这种支撑 PDEC，但全局仍需证明它不可能持久发生，或把持久失败继续送入相位/SAE/ColumnCRT 证书。

decision_rows.meaning: no-slot 支撑不是多重负载；每个支撑点有唯一 b 和唯一 q=P-2b。
总 no-slot 负载已经精确化为激活尾支撑上的素数计数。
若 `PrimeWindow<=2*NoSlotLoad` 失败发生，formal unit 已有唯一支撑证书格式。
有限扫描 P<=5000 中未发现总压力支撑 PDEC。
仍需全局证明平方窗最终幸存数不能小于两倍激活尾支撑素数负载。
本步只把总压力缺陷登记为更尖锐的支撑 PDEC，不关闭全局行/列命题。
